biography.value:
Description

This brilliantly colored young adult dragon has scales, teeth, and claws made of multicolored crystal, and its wings are sheets of flexible glass.

Defense

AC 35, touch 8, flat-footed 35 (+27 natural, -2 size)

hp 256 [361] (19d12+133)

mp 132

Fort +19, Ref +12, Will +15

DR 10/magic;

Immune Paralysis, Sleep;

SR 27

Offense

Speed 60 ft., Climb 30 ft., Fly 200 ft. (poor)

Melee Bite +23 (2d8+12 plus 1d6 non-elemental damage/19-20), 2 Claws +22 (2d6+8), Tail Slap +20 (2d6+12), 2 Wings +20 (1d8+4)

Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)

Special Abilities Crimson Roar, Dragon Force

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (50-ft. Cone, 18d4 non-elemental, Reflex DC 26 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Miasma, Sonic Tail

Spells Known (FC CL 19th, Concentration +26)

At will (DC 17) - Amanuensis, Detect Magic, Mending, Message Moment, Read Magic

1st (DC 18) - Anticipate Peril, Deceleration, Mage Armor, True Strike

2nd (DC 19) - Clockwork Timer, Delay Response, Lesser Celerity, Recall Agony, Slow Magic, Time Shudder

3rd (DC 20) - Alter Fortune, Blink, Dimension Step, Dispel, Haste, Mass Deceleration, Slow

4th (DC 21) - Baleful Blink, Celerity, Dimension Door, Temporal Jolt, Time Shield

5th (DC 22) - Anticipatory Strike, Greater Blink, Second Chance, Temporary Repair

6th (DC 23) - 24 Hours, Age Resistance, Contingency, Greater Dispel, Hastega, Mass Recall Agony, Slowga

Statistics

Str 30, Dex 10, Con 25, Int 18, Wis 20, Cha 24

Base Atk +19; CMB +31; CMD 41 (45 vs. trip)

Feats Deceitful, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (Bite), Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (Bite)

Skills Bluff +34, Climb +41, Disguise +31, Fly +15, Intimidate +30, Knowledge (Dungeoneering) +27, Knowledge (Geography) +27, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +15; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb

Languages Common, Draconic +4 others (DM's choice)

SQ Razor Sharp

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds as a standard action, a crystal dragon lets loose a ferocious roar that affects allies within 30 feet. Affected creatures gain a morale bonus to damage rolls equal to crystal dragon's Charisma modifier for 1d6 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 23).

description.value: 1/day, a crystal dragon releases the dragon soul within, improving itself or an ally by touch. This ability grants the subject an increase to all physical damage, melee and range, by +1 per three caster levels. It also grants the subject an increase to all magical damage and healing by +1 per three caster levels. This ability lasts for a minute. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31).

description.value: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, with a great, heaving breath does the crystal dragon belch forth a cloud of noxious mist. As a standard action, the crystal dragon deals 5d6 non-elemental damage to all enemies in a 30 ft. cone; a successful Reflex save (DC 26) halves this damage. All enemies within the area of effect who failed the Reflex save must make a series of saves (DC 26) to avoid each of the following effects: Disease (Fort), Silence (Will), Sap (Fort), and Slow (Will), all of which last for 1d8 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th-level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 25).

description.value: All of a crystal dragon's natural attacks deal slashing damage.

A crystal dragon will vibrate its tail sending out sonic waves around itself and those within a 20-ft. radius around himself. Anyone caught in the sonic waves takes 5d4 points of non-elemental damage and are Dazed for 1 round unless they make a Reflex save (DC 26) to take half of the damage and negate the status effect. This ability can also shatter anyone who is already petrified unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 26). Anyone who cannot hear is immune to this effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 21).
